content.title: Paying permit fees
content.summary: In Arvada, CO, permit fees can be paid online, in-person at City Hall, or by mail. Payment methods include credit cards online, cash or check in-person, and checks or money orders sent by mail. A use tax is required on building permit applications, and fees are calculated based on the project's total valuation as outlined in the city's Building Fee Schedule.
content.body:
In Arvada, CO, permit fees can be paid online, in-person, or by mail. Once your permit or project is approved, you will receive an email notification. Fees can be estimated beforehand using the [Fee Estimator]([NEW PORTAL URL]). 

Payment Methods 

- **Online:** You can pay using Visa, Mastercard, Discover, or American Express via the [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]). Simply log in to your account, click the permit fees highlighted in blue, and proceed to checkout.
- **In-Person:** You can visit Arvada City Hall (8101 Ralston Road) during regular business hours and pay with cash, check, or credit card.
- **By Mail:** You can send a check or money order to **Arvada City Hall, Attention: Engineering, 8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, CO 80002**. Important Details 

- **Use Tax:** The City of Arvada requires a use tax to be collected on every building permit application. You can present your issued permit to your materials vendor at the time of purchase to have local tax removed. - **Fee Calculation:** Permit costs are based on the total valuation of your project and standard plan review fees. You can review the structure in the [City of Arvada Building Fee Schedule](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1263/Building-Fee-Schedule).
